description: Taxonomical grounding for THERMALIS-X. Strictly decouples raw sensor observations, clustered events, physical source classifications, baseline abnormality states, and administrative operational decisions.

ontology_entities.Observation: A single spaceborne instrument pixel measurement (e.g. VIIRS I4/I5 or MODIS B21/B31) with timestamp, coordinate, FRP, and brightness temperature.
ontology_entities.Event: A spatiotemporally contiguous cluster of observations formed via ST-DBSCAN within spatial radius eps_s (1.25 km) and temporal window eps_t (24 hours).
ontology_entities.Episode: A longitudinal sequence of events linked through split, merge, or continuation lineage over multi-week or multi-month intervals.
ontology_entities.Incident: An administrative emergency management entity declared by a District Disaster Management Authority (DDMA) or Fire Officer.
ontology_entities.Attribution: The spatial and operational association between an event and an industrial facility boundary (inside footprint vs off-site perimeter).
ontology_entities.Abnormality: A statistical excursion of thermal radiative power relative to a facility's robust rolling 180-day Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) baseline.
ontology_entities.Decision: An operational action taken by an analyst or automated response system (e.g. Cordon Perimeter, Dispatch NDRF/SDRF, Task Optical Satellite, Monitor CEMS).

classes.name: Industrial Accident / Uncontrolled Blaze
classes.definition: Uncontrolled accidental fire occurring within or immediately adjacent to an industrial facility, characterized by significant baseline FRP excursion, spatial perimeter dilation, and anomalous smoke/plume drift.

classes.name: Industrial Normal Operational Heat
classes.definition: Routine, steady-state high-temperature manufacturing processes (e.g. cement kilns, electric arc furnaces, ceramic kilns) operating within historical baseline MAD bounds.

classes.name: Operational Gas Flare Stack
classes.definition: Point-source combustion of associated petroleum gas or process relief gas at refineries, petrochemical complexes, or offshore platforms.

classes.name: Wildfire / Forest Fire
classes.definition: Uncontrolled vegetation fire in forest, shrubland, or grassland terrains, characterized by high perimeter spread velocity, large dynamic areal footprint, and forest landcover.

classes.name: Agricultural Crop Residue Burn
classes.definition: Controlled post-harvest stubble burning (paddy/wheat straw) occurring in agricultural parcels, typically seasonal, short-lived, and low-to-moderate FRP.

classes.name: Mining Heat / Coal Seam Smoldering
classes.definition: Thermal emissions from open-cast mining operations, coal seam fires, or overburden spoil dumps, characterized by multi-year spatial stationarity and moderate, steady FRP.
evidence_requirements: Moderate FRP with low high-frequency variance

classes.name: Thermal Power Generation Heat
classes.definition: Radiative heat signatures from thermal power generation boilers, cooling systems, or coal handling facilities operating within environmental norms.

classes.name: Other Natural Thermal Sources
classes.definition: Volcanic activity, hydrothermal vents, or solar specular reflectance from desert sands or salt pans.

classes.name: Sensor Artifact / False Alarm
classes.definition: Spurious detection caused by sun glint, cloud edge reflectance, high-albedo solar panels, or instrument transient noise.
evidence_requirements: Single transient observation without temporal confirmation

classes.name: Uncertain / Conformal Abstention Candidate
classes.definition: Ambiguous event where sensor evidence is degraded (e.g. cloud cover), multi-class probability entropy is high (H > 0.60), or conflicting features prevent safe automated classification.
